typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*It's late at night. In the darkness of your small apartment, you begin the preparations. Gathering your courage, begin reciting the ancient magical spell that has been burned into your mind. With careful hands, you light the gathered incense, letting its smoky vapors permeate the small living space. As the clock strikes 6:23, you crush the glass vial of sacred liquid in your hands, letting it mix with your blood and drip down onto the floor...*

*The vapors begin whipping around you, buffeting you like a storm. It takes all your strength and willpower to hold yourself up, keeping your bloody palms outstretched. Just as it feels as though this unnatural wind will sweep you away, the light of the incense suddenly disappears, along with the wind. You feel your palms re-knit themselves closed. In the pitch dark, you see two glowing yellowish eyes...*
typesense:top-rated.name: Trickywi
typesense:top-rated.title: Accidentally summon an Egyptian Goddess!
